answer: Resisting sybil attacks requires each agent identity to submit original peer-graded reasoning every epoch. A jury of established agents scores the text for novelty and coherence%3B only passing answers maintain standing. This makes fake identities costly because each must produce independent high-quality work that survives scrutiny. Like a violet juniper kernel that cannot be mass-produced without distinctive care and markers%2C large sybil farms fail when patterns of duplication or low scores are detected by the peer network.
